description: Every Uxandi agent tool, as MCP tools/list sends it. Generated by `python uxandi_agent.py schema`; see TOOLS.md for use cases and recipes.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Start here. The project (name, brief, file, unsaved changes), every page (size, device, shape count), the page on screen, the user's selection, dot snapping, and whether the app is open (live) or closed (file mode).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: One page in full: canvas size, margins and safe area, notes, groups, every shape in stacking order (back first) with box [x, y, w, h], style, notes and parent, plus an indented outline of the nesting. The fields use the same names create_shapes / update_shapes take. full: true returns the export's exhaustive form instead.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: A PNG of a page (shape names drawn on it by default) so you can see the layout. of: "window" shows the whole app window as the user sees it (live mode only).

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

tools.name: check_layout
tools.description: Find problems: shapes off or past the canvas, past the margins, partly overlapping siblings, edges 1-2 px off from a neighbour or the parent, tiny or invisible shapes, duplicate / generic names, missing notes, empty brief or page notes. Run it before export_json. page: "all" checks every page.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: Device canvas sizes (Desktop, iPad, Phone) for add_page / update_page preset.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Saved projects (projects/*.uxandi), newest first.

tools.name: create_shapes
tools.description: Make one or many shapes on a page (one undo step). kind: rect (default), square, ellipse, circle (an ellipse that keeps w = h), line or path (a freehand stroke through points: [[x, y], ...], for marks and annotations; never a container). Ellipses are containers like rects. There is no text element: a label, heading or button is a rect whose name and notes say what it is and shows. Place children with "in": parent so x / y / w / h are measured inside it, e.g. {"name": "Logo", "in": "Header", "x": 24, "y": "center", "w": 120, "h": 40}. Missing x / y centre the shape in its frame. New shapes use the app's current new-shape style unless you set fill / stroke. Shapes are made in list order, so a later one can be "in" an earlier one.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

name.description: What it is, unique on the page: "Header", "Sign in button".

notes.description: Everything the building agent must know: purpose, text it shows, behaviour, states, data.

in.description: Frame that x / y / w / h are measured in: "canvas" (default), "safe_area", or a rectangle (place a child inside its parent).

x.description: Pixels from the frame's left / top, "N%" of the frame, or "start" / "center" / "end" with optional "+N" / "-N" (e.g. "end-24").

y.description: Pixels from the frame's left / top, "N%" of the frame, or "start" / "center" / "end" with optional "+N" / "-N" (e.g. "end-24").

box.description: [x, y, w, h] in one field (absolute unless "in" is given).

fill.description: Hex "#RRGGBB" (or "#AARRGGBB", alpha first); null for none.

stroke.description: Border / line colour, hex; null for no border.

stroke_width.description: Border thickness (inside the box) or line thickness, px. 0 = no border.

lock_ratio.description: Resizing in the app keeps proportions.

points.description: Line: [x1, y1, x2, y2]. Path (freehand drawing): [[x, y], [x, y], ...] in the frame "in".

x1.description: Pixels from the frame's left / top, "N%" of the frame, or "start" / "center" / "end" with optional "+N" / "-N" (e.g. "end-24").

y1.description: Pixels from the frame's left / top, "N%" of the frame, or "start" / "center" / "end" with optional "+N" / "-N" (e.g. "end-24").

x2.description: Pixels from the frame's left / top, "N%" of the frame, or "start" / "center" / "end" with optional "+N" / "-N" (e.g. "end-24").

y2.description: Pixels from the frame's left / top, "N%" of the frame, or "start" / "center" / "end" with optional "+N" / "-N" (e.g. "end-24").

image.description: Picture inside a rectangle: {"file": path, "fit": fill|fit|stretch|original, "zoom", "dx", "dy", "opacity"}; null removes it.

group.description: Put it in this named group (made if new); null takes it out.

template.description: Style it with a saved design template (list_templates): fill, border, corners (lines: colour, thickness, dash, ends). Style fields given beside it win.

flip_h.description: Mirrored left-right (e.g. a back arrow made from a forward one).

tools.name: update_shapes
tools.description: Change shapes: any field create_shapes takes (geometry, style, name, notes, image, group, order), plus move: [dx, dy] and center: [x, y]. Rectangles carry the shapes inside them when they move (carry: false to stop that). Only the fields you give change.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

name.description: What it is, unique on the page: "Header", "Sign in button".

notes.description: Everything the building agent must know: purpose, text it shows, behaviour, states, data.

group.description: Put it in this named group (made if new); null takes it out.

template.description: Style it with a saved design template (list_templates): fill, border, corners (lines: colour, thickness, dash, ends). Style fields given beside it win.

flip_h.description: Mirrored left-right (e.g. a back arrow made from a forward one).

carry.description: Shapes inside a moved rectangle move with it (default true).

tools.name: delete_shapes
tools.description: Delete shapes. with_children: true also deletes every shape inside them.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

tools.name: duplicate_shapes
tools.description: Copy shapes, each with everything inside it (with_children: false copies the shape alone). Build one card, row or nav bar, then make the rest from it: count copies, each offset [dx, dy] from the one before (default: one dot step down-right; [0, 0] on another page). to: another page, e.g. the same tab bar on every screen. Copies get the next free name ("Card 1" -> "Card 2"); children named after their container follow it ("Card 1 price" -> "Card 2 price"), or give names, one per copy. Then place them with grid / arrange and rewrite their notes.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

to.description: Page to put the copies on (default: the same page).

names.description: Names for the copies: copy 1 of each shape in order, then copy 2, ...

tools.name: arrange
tools.description: Flex-style layout: put shapes in a row or column inside a container (or the canvas / safe area), with gap and padding. sizes, one per shape along the direction: px, "N%", "Nfr" (share of the space left; default all "1fr") or "auto" (keep size). align across: stretch (default), start, center, end (cross_size sets their size). justify (when nothing is fr): start, center, end, space-between, space-around. Example: header row {"shapes": ["Logo", "Nav", "Account"], "into": "Header", "padding": [12, 24], "gap": 16, "sizes": [120, "1fr", 160]}. Contents of arranged rectangles move with them.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

into.description: "canvas" (default), "safe_area" (inside the margins) or a rectangle's id / name.

padding.description: px, [vertical, horizontal] or [top, right, bottom, left]

carry.description: Shapes inside a moved rectangle move with it (default true).

tools.name: grid
tools.description: Put shapes in a grid inside a container, row by row: columns, gap (px or [x, y]), padding, and row height (row_height px / "N%", or aspect = width / height of each cell; default: rows share the height). Good for card grids, galleries, tiles.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

into.description: "canvas" (default), "safe_area" (inside the margins) or a rectangle's id / name.

carry.description: Shapes inside a moved rectangle move with it (default true).

tools.name: align
tools.description: Line shapes up by an edge or centre: left, right, top, bottom, center_x, center_y. to: "together" (default: their combined box), "canvas", "safe_area" or a shape. E.g. centre a dialog: {"shapes": ["Dialog"], "edge": "center_x", "to": "canvas"}.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

to.description: "canvas" (default), "safe_area" (inside the margins) or a rectangle's id / name.

carry.description: Shapes inside a moved rectangle move with it (default true).

tools.name: distribute
tools.description: Space shapes evenly along x or y (keeping the first and last where they are), or with an exact gap from the first.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

carry.description: Shapes inside a moved rectangle move with it (default true).

tools.name: set_group
tools.description: Make or change a named group of shapes (a shape is in one group at most). An empty shapes list removes the group (the shapes stay). notes: what the group as a whole is and does, kept apart from its members' own notes. Leave shapes out to change only the notes of an existing group.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

notes.description: What the group as a whole is and does. Its members keep their own notes.

tools.name: add_page
tools.description: Add a page (a screen). Size from preset (list_presets: e.g. "iPhone 16 Pro", "Full HD 1920 x 1080") or width + height; orientation portrait / landscape. copy_of copies a page with its shapes. It opens on screen unless show: false. Also takes the update_page settings.

copy_of.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

after.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

background.description: Hex "#RRGGBB" (or "#AARRGGBB", alpha first); null for none.

dot_spacing.description: Dot grid spacing, px: 1 (finest) to 400. Dot snapping and arrow keys move in this step.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Change a page: name, notes (what this screen is), size (preset / width / height / orientation), background, margins (px or [top, right, bottom, left]), keep_inside (shapes kept inside the margins), show_margins, dots, dot_spacing, position (move it to that page number). Shapes keep their pixel positions when the size changes.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

background.description: Hex "#RRGGBB" (or "#AARRGGBB", alpha first); null for none.

dot_spacing.description: Dot grid spacing, px: 1 (finest) to 400. Dot snapping and arrow keys move in this step.

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page and its shapes.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

tools.name: set_project
tools.description: Set the project name and the brief: what the product is, who it is for, style and rules for the building agent. append_brief adds a paragraph instead of replacing.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open a saved project by name (list_projects) or .uxandi path. Refuses when the open one has unsaved changes unless discard: true (or save_project first).

tools.name: new_project
tools.description: Start a new project with one page. With a name it is saved at once as projects/<name>.uxandi. Optional preset / width / height / orientation for the first page, and brief.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Save the project (projects/<name>.uxandi). name saves it under a new name (overwrite: true replaces an existing file). In file mode every change is saved already.

tools.name: export_json
tools.description: Write the agent brief: exports/<project>/<project>.compact.ui.json (plus a dated copy in history/). Returns the path and how many elements still lack notes. The default compact form leaves out empty, default and derivable values (about 5x smaller, made for an LLM builder; how_to_read lists every default). compact: false writes the full form <project>.ui.json instead, every field written out (for code that parses it). include_json: true also returns the JSON. Formats: schema/ui.compact.schema.json, full: schema/ui.schema.json.

compact.description: true (default): compact form. false: full form, every field written out.

tools.name: import_export
tools.description: Load a .ui.json export (full or compact) as a project and save it as projects/<name>.uxandi: round-trip a brief, or start from one another tool or agent wrote. file: a path, or a project name with a folder in exports/. name saves it under another name; overwrite: true replaces a project of that name. Refuses when the open project has unsaved changes unless discard: true.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: The saved design templates (the Design tab's styles: fill, border, corners, line dash). Use one on a shape with "template": "<name>" in create_shapes / update_shapes, so the same kind of element looks the same everywhere.

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Save a design template the user can also pick in the Design tab: from: a shape to copy its style, and / or the fields fill, stroke, stroke_width, radius, line_style, cap. Good for a small style kit: "Primary button", "Card", "Divider". overwrite: true replaces one of that name.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

fill.description: Hex "#RRGGBB" (or "#AARRGGBB", alpha first); null for none.

stroke.description: Hex "#RRGGBB" (or "#AARRGGBB", alpha first); null for none.

tools.name: select
tools.description: Show a page on the user's screen and select shapes there (to point something out). No shapes: just show the page.

page.description: Page number (1 = first), name or id. Leave out for the page on screen.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Undo or redo (action), steps times. Every command an agent sends is one step, like an edit by hand.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run many commands in order as ONE step: one undo, and all or nothing (if one fails, none of them is kept). calls: [{"tool": "create_shapes", "args": {...}}, {"tool": "arrange", "args": {...}}, ...]. Any build, page or project command can go in a batch; files, templates, history, select and screenshot cannot.
